patch.name: region_menu
patch.title: Region menu (COUNTRY ASSIGNMENTS)
patch.description:
The game has a region menu (Universe, Japan, U.S.A., Export, Australia, Korea) that its program never opens: the function that decides it always says no. With this patch, hold VIEW CHANGE while pressing Test: the test mode opens on COUNTRY ASSIGNMENTS (Service changes the country, Test leaves). Test alone opens the usual test menu.
The region changes the game's texts and settings like the other versions (ecaj, ecau): a new region may reset the coin settings (free play), check them in COIN ASSIGNMENTS.
A patch of the program EPROMs (EPR-22903 to EPR-22906), made by Scripts/RomPatches/unlocks.py.
